free_tier.stated: Get $15 free credits per month (≈ 2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes). Credits can be used across available services. The macOS a2-standard-4 machine is priced at $0.09 a minute; the $15 credit at $0.09 a minute is about 167 macOS minutes, which is an arithmetic conversion and not a stated macOS allowance.
free_tier.notes: The monthly credit is stated in USD and denominated in Ubuntu minutes; no macOS-specific free minute allowance is published. The existing ci-cd-runners/semaphore-cloud record prices the same credit on Ubuntu machines.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a CI machine, not an object; no artifact size cap was found in the pages read

retention.stated: the macOS job agent and every file on it are discarded when the job ends; no separate macOS artifact retention was stated on the pages read

egress.terms: Free up to 20 GB/month egress and 100 GB/month storage. Additional usage: $0.35/GB egress and $0.07/GB storage. This is the general artifact allowance; no macOS-specific egress term is stated.

interface_detail: a pipeline YAML in a GitHub, Bitbucket or GitLab repository; the sem CLI opens an SSH session into a running job
tooling: pipeline YAML (.semaphore/semaphore.yml) with the a2-standard-4 machine and a macOS Xcode image; the sem CLI and the visual workflow editor. The Semaphore Community Edition is software the user installs and runs on a rented or free machine, listed here after the hosted macOS runner.
chaining: the shared USD 15 monthly credit also spends on macOS a2-standard-4 minutes at $0.09 a minute, so the credit buys fewer macOS minutes than Linux minutes; artifacts leave free to 20 GB a month.

limits.value: $15 of credit a month shared across machines; on the macOS a2-standard-4 at $0.09 a minute that is about 167 minutes, derived from USD 15 / USD 0.09 per minute
20 concurrent jobs by default; higher limits on request

limits_note: the machine is an a2-standard-4 with 4 virtual CPUs, Apple Silicon, 8 GB memory and 150 GB disk, paired with macOS Xcode26 or Xcode27
binding_note: the shared USD 15 monthly credit is what runs out first at $0.09 a macOS minute, well before the 20 concurrent jobs; the monthly dollar pool is recorded as volume-quota as in the other hosted CI records.

identity_cost.detail: the signup page offers Signup with GitHub, Signup with Bitbucket and Signup with GitLab, each asking for the identity and email scope of that provider; the pricing page links Start free to id.semaphoreci.com/signup. No card is asked for at signup on the pages read.

reliability_note: the macOS job runs on an ephemeral agent destroyed when the job ends; the pricing page states no macOS-specific SLA
confidence_note: the macOS machine price, the shared credit, the concurrency, the egress terms and the signup providers are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25; no job was run.
